A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DitHub research. Their complete main texts and appendices, including equations, tables and figures, support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: V2 reports original ODinW-13 and ODinW-O experiments, few-shot evaluations, component ablations, forgetting measurements and unlearning results.

after.justification: V3 retains those original experiments and adds LoRA-rank, Swin-B backbone and AODRaw results.

M1.justification: The warmup, class-specific A matrices, shared B matrix, merging updates and inference procedures remain unchanged. Additional rank and backbone evaluations do not revise the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: Section D.4 adds AODRaw evaluation across nine overlapping-class domains involving fog, rain, lighting changes and indoor/outdoor conditions. ODinW-13, ODinW-O and COCO remain. Although Table I incorrectly names ODinW-13 in its caption, its domain columns and Section D.4 identify the added coverage.

E2.justification: V3 adds an explicit efficiency comparison against ZiRa in Figure 7's performance-memory panel, extending v2's memory comparison against the Grounding DINO encoder. Comparator membership in the retained benchmark and EnE comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: Added evaluations use LoRA ranks 1, 2, 4 and 8 alongside rank 16, test a larger Swin-B backbone, and measure ZCOCO for component ablations. These extend experimental configurations; the original full/few-shot protocols, merging coefficients and optimization settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V3 substantially expands efficiency and scalability analysis through the rank-memory-performance sweep, per-task rank results and Swin-B evaluation. It also adds zero-shot retention to the component ablation. Existing forgetting, rare-class and unlearning analyses remain; the rearranged horse/TV examples are not new cases.

E5.justification: Both versions report three runs with different random seeds and the same standard deviations in Appendix D.1, renumbered from Tables E/F to F/G. No new uncertainty-estimation or significance-testing procedure is introduced.

E6.justification: New results include Swin-B averages of 67.03 for DitHub versus 65.09 for ZiRa, and AODRaw averages of 34.03 versus 32.34. Rank-sweep and zero-shot ablation entries are added. The component-chart value changes from 62.13 to 62.19, while the original benchmark tables remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The objectives, class-overlap definition and merging mathematics retain their substance. V3 clarifies additive adaptation notation and separately numbers the existing LoRA formula; it adds no substantive mathematical assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the modular-library proposal, first compositional-study claim and state-of-the-art claims on ODinW-13 and ODinW-O. Additional experiments support these contributions without redefining them.

C2.justification: V3 attributes low-rank robustness to class-specific modularity and discusses the specialization–zero-shot trade-off. It newly attributes the Base variant's unusually high ZCOCO score to forgetting and coincidental alignment with COCO. The limitations in Appendix F remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The added studies specify the tested LoRA ranks and use of publicly available pretrained Grounding DINO with Swin-B. Appendix E's hardware, optimizer, training-time and storage disclosures remain unchanged, with little additional implementation detail for the new benchmark.

R1.justification: V3 adds the AODRaw reference, 'Towards raw object detection in diverse conditions.' The related-work discussion and positioning relative to incremental detection, LoRA and model merging otherwise remain substantively unchanged.

P1.justification: V3 makes localized wording and notation edits, reorganizes Section 5.2 and the appendix overview, and adds funding acknowledgments and an ethics statement. The main narrative and most existing sections are retained.

P2.justification: Experimental displays expand through new Tables C, H and I and a combined ablation/memory Figure 7 with added ZCOCO bars. The sensitivity figure moves, and the existing unlearning examples are rearranged horizontally and relabeled. These substantially revise the experimental presentation.

improvement.justification: V3 strengthens v2's evidence for scalability and broader applicability through rank, Swin-B and AODRaw evaluations, while making the zero-shot trade-off visible. The gain is limited by sparse setup details for the added evaluations, unreconciled memory figures in Figure 7 versus Appendix E, and Table I's incorrect benchmark caption.
